name: The Royal Copenhagen City Half
description:
A flat half marathon on closed roads through Copenhagen. The route starts at the harbour in Nordhavn and passes Kastellet, Amalienborg, Nyhavn, the Black Diamond and Lille Langebro before finishing at Royal Arena in Ørestad. Flat asphalt with under 16 metres of elevation, long straight stretches and few turns—suitable both for your first half marathon and for chasing a new PR.

The first edition in April 2026 had 2,758 finishers from 66 nations. Around 10,000 runners are expected in 2027.
additional:
Start at 09:30, 2 minutes from Orientkaj Metro. From the finish, it’s 10 minutes by metro to the airport.
The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a digital certificate, refreshment stations approximately every 5 km and free baggage transport from start to finish.
Prices: DKK 695 until 16/1-2027 · DKK 895 from 17/1 · DKK 1,095 from 28/2. Minimum age: 15.
Please note: This is the spring race on 11 April 2027, not the Copenhagen Half Marathon in September.

location: Vester Allé ved ARoS, Aarhus C
description: Royal Aarhus City Marathon is the first city marathon in Aarhus since 2008. The route is one lap of 42.195 km, starting and finishing on Vester Allé by ARoS. You’ll run through the Marselisborg Forests, along the bay and past the Infinite Bridge, across the harbour and out to Aarhus Ø, past Dokk1 and the Cathedral, and around Brabrand Lake before returning to the city centre. The highest point on the route is 60 metres, and around 20 km are car-free paths and pedestrian streets. The time limit is 6 hours. The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a running shirt, aid stations every 5 km with water and sports drink, baggage storage and a digital certificate. Early bird price: DKK 695 through 24 December 2026; afterwards, DKK 795. The organiser is Strata Endurance Events, which also organises Royal Copenhagen City Half and Ørestad Half Marathon.
additional: Start at 09:00 on Sunday 10 October 2027 on Vester Allé by ARoS; finish at the same location. Interactive route map: https://racm-map.vercel.app · Strava route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3550794644934219702. The route is provisional pending final approval from Aarhus Municipality and the police.

name: Guldfeber Aarhus — Golden Fever #1
description:
Gold Fever — Denmark’s first SplitRace tournament. A free running game in the streets of Aarhus: 12 segments (0.4–1.9 km) are mapped around the city, and 7 of them form a hidden “golden chain” — nobody knows which ones, or in what order. Find them. Run them. Chase the times.

No mass start and no entry fee: run whenever you want, as often as you want, throughout 17 October – 1 November. The app measures your times via GPS. You earn points for each golden segment based on how close you are to the fastest time — women are scored against the fastest woman, men against the fastest man. Extra points go to the first runners to unlock a golden segment — and the tournament’s biggest bonus goes to the first to complete the whole chain in the correct order.

This is the first edition — a pilot for a maximum of 30 runners. Your feedback will shape the game.

(EN: A free city-wide running game in Aarhus. 12 segments, 7 of them secretly form a golden chain — find them and beat the clock. No mass start: run anytime 17 Oct – 1 Nov. Free entry, GPS timing in the SplitRace app. First edition, 30 pilot spots.)
additional: No start line and no start groups — all segments are on public, lit routes around Aarhus, and you can run them whenever you want during the event window. Participation requires the free SplitRace app (iOS / Android) — download it via splitrace.app, join the “Guldfeber Aarhus” tournament, and all 12 segments will appear on your map. Limited to the first 30 runners. Open streets: follow normal traffic rules. Questions? Write to support@splitrace.app or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/split_race/
